g.text: Separate entity inventories and timing statements; neither panel measures independent biological information.

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: end; fill: #50636d
font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172c37

g.text: C Molecular inventories — independent axes and units

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #50636d

g.text: Protein panels use different assay technologies. Source-wide inventories do not imply complete measurements in each person.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #50636d

g.text: Glycan peaks may contain multiple structures; derived traits are calculated features, not additional independent acquisitions.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #172c37

g.text: D Timing and repetition — distinct source meanings

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #50636d

g.text: Visit medians, sampling intervals, regimen spans, treatment sessions and wear windows are not a common “duration” axis.

text.style: font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #50636d

g.text: UK Biobank wear window is for a subset. CIRCULATE treatment sessions are not sampling occasions. No values were imputed.

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #50636d

g.text: Sources: [1] iPOP/iHMP · [2] CIRCULATE TPE · [3] UK Biobank resource · [4] UKB-PPP · [5] Human Phenotype Project
